summary: @servicetitan/line-item-editor preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from the oven-sh GitHub releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line Bun-CJS bundle beginning with `// @bun @bun-cjs`, followed by string-array rotation obfuscation (rotate function shifting a large hex/integer literal table) and hex-named identifiers, rendering the payload unreadable without executing it under Bun. A React grid/line-item UI component package has no legitimate reason to pull an alternate language runtime at install and use it to execute a compiled/obfuscated blob outside the Node.js code path. The alternate-runtime-dropper shape (fresh Bun install used to execute the shipped opaque payload, deliberately outside the Node.js path that standard supply-chain scanners inspect), the mismatch with the package's advertised UI-library purpose, and the install-time auto-execution together constitute arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine on every `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
